prose.subject: Payment Required: Access Your Wexcombe Catering Report
prose.body:
Thank you for requesting your detailed catering analysis from Wexcombe Catering. To unlock the full report, please complete the payment below.

This document contains a comprehensive breakdown of your recent order, including itemized costs, delivery logistics, and dietary accommodation summaries. It is designed to provide full transparency into the service provided to your event.

The total price for this report is 8057.29 USDC. This amount covers the generation, curation, and secure delivery of the data.

To proceed, please send the payment to the following address: 0x7564374b67c65d268b8b7ee2ba200b90a9d0443d

Once the transaction is confirmed on the network, the report will be available for download immediately. Please ensure you send the exact amount to avoid processing delays. Our team monitors the address for incoming payments to guarantee a quick turnaround.

If you have any questions regarding the invoice details or the contents of the report, feel free to reach out to our support team. We appreciate your business and look forward to serving you again.
